title: Reindexing a sign cube
statement: Let $\kappa$ and $\iota$ be types, let $e:\kappa\simeq\iota$ be a bijection, and let the sign set be $\{1,-1\}$. Reindexing functions by $e$ gives a bijection from sign-valued functions on $\kappa$ to sign-valued functions on $\iota$, sending $x$ to the function $i\mapsto x(e^{-1}(i))$.
